import struct,json,math,hashlib,sys
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,timezone
from tensorboard.compat.proto.event_pb2 import Event
from tensorboard.compat.tensorflow_stub.pywrap_tensorflow import masked_crc32c
assert Path(sys.prefix).name=='isaacsim-5.1'
root=Path.cwd(); run='2026-10-01_00-04-08'; base=root/'learnings/policy_tuning/RobotLab-Isaac-Velocity-Flat-LW-wheel-Roa-v0'/run
p=next((root/'logs/rsl_rl/LW_wheel_flat_roa'/run).glob('events.out.tfevents.*'))
before=p.stat(); start=max(0,before.st_size-2*1024*1024)
with p.open('rb') as f: f.seek(start); data=f.read()
def valid_at(i):
 if i+16>len(data):return False
 length=struct.unpack_from('<Q',data,i)[0]
 if length>2**20 or i+16+length>len(data):return False
 return masked_crc32c(data[i:i+8])==struct.unpack_from('<I',data,i+8)[0] and masked_crc32c(data[i+12:i+12+length])==struct.unpack_from('<I',data,i+12+length)[0]
i=next(i for i in range(min(131072,len(data)-16)) if valid_at(i)); initial=i; tags={}; records=0
while valid_at(i):
 n=struct.unpack_from('<Q',data,i)[0]; event=Event.FromString(data[i+12:i+12+n]); records+=1
 for value in event.summary.value:
  if value.HasField('simple_value'):tags.setdefault(value.tag,[]).append((event.step,float(value.simple_value)))
 i+=n+16
assert start+i==before.st_size
selected=['Train/mean_reward','Train/mean_episode_length','Perf/total_fps','Loss/value_function','Loss/surrogate','Loss/hist_latent','Loss/vel_loss','Policy/mean_noise_std','Episode_Termination/illegal_contact','Episode_Termination/time_out','Metrics/base_velocity/error_vel_xy','Metrics/base_velocity/error_vel_yaw']
selected += ['VelocityDiagnostics/student/command_zero/'+k for k in ['sample_count','actual_vx_mean_m_s','estimated_vx_mean_m_s','bias_vx_m_s','rmse_vx_m_s']]
selected += ['VelocityCurriculum/'+k+'/estimated_fraction' for k in ['student','teacher']]
summary={}
for tag in selected:
 vals=tags[tag]; tail=vals[-100:]; assert all(math.isfinite(v) for s,v in vals)
 summary[tag]={'last_step':vals[-1][0],'last_value':vals[-1][1],'tail_count':len(tail),'tail_first_step':tail[0][0],'tail_last_step':tail[-1][0],'tail_mean':sum(v for s,v in tail)/len(tail),'tail_min':min(v for s,v in tail),'tail_max':max(v for s,v in tail),'observations':tail}
assert summary['Train/mean_reward']['last_step']==49999
h=hashlib.sha256()
with p.open('rb') as f:
 while chunk:=f.read(8*1024*1024):h.update(chunk)
after=p.stat(); assert (before.st_size,before.st_mtime_ns)==(after.st_size,after.st_mtime_ns)
def reference(path):return {'path':str(path.resolve()),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
value={'version':1,'created_at':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'analysis_kind':'bounded_final_training_tail','run_id':run,'training_log':{'path':str(p.resolve()),'sha256':h.hexdigest(),'size_bytes':before.st_size,'mtime_ns':before.st_mtime_ns},'tail':{'read_bytes':len(data),'tail_sha256':hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),'first_crc_valid_record_offset':start+initial,'complete_records':records,'all_complete_record_crcs_checked':True,'end_offset':start+i,'trailing_bytes':len(data)-i},'run_identity':reference(base/'provenance/context-50737a142e11a9a1096d8729617c8e16ddea450a1d6db4864ff0a1b7ce0ffef7.json'),'effective_config':reference(base/'provenance/config-e8e4b3da5a8ac9435411385ee2c48eb554823bd48d8030b013aa976540481952.json'),'checkpoint':reference(root/'logs/rsl_rl/LW_wheel_flat_roa'/run/'model_49999.pt'),'scalars':summary,'analysis_source':{'python':program,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(program.encode()).hexdigest()},'assessment':{'convergence':'indeterminate','reason':'No user-approved acceptance thresholds; only the final 2 MiB of training records were summarized.'},'limitations':['Tail scalar averages are not controlled deployment tests.','Loss/hist_latent and Loss/vel_loss last occur at student step 49980, not step 49999.','Training rewards use this run reward configuration and are not cross-run performance scores.']}
out=base/'evidence/training/final-tail-20261002-001.json'; out.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
with out.open('x',encoding='utf-8') as f:json.dump(value,f,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False);f.write('\n')
assert reference(out)['sha256']==hashlib.sha256(out.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
print(json.dumps({'evidence':reference(out),'scalars':{k:{z:v for z,v in d.items() if z!='observations'} for k,d in summary.items()}},ensure_ascii=False))
